readme.en:
SecureGen by LinkGen Systems™ helps you manage your alarm and coordinate selected lights and shades from Homey. Choose the lighting LINK you want to use from the LINK Wall without rebuilding the same lighting Flow, or enable automatic shade actions for an alarm. Your devices stay paired with their existing apps, with no need for a separate virtual copy of every light or shade.

SecureGen currently works with Ring through the Community Ring app for Homey. The full Ring setup requires Advanced Flow, with setup guidance available in SecureGen Settings. Ring mode requests and reported state use these Flows, while SecureGen controls selected lights and shades directly through Homey’s device API. SecureGen is an independent LinkGen Systems app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ring.
